display.tagline: Replies to the right posts with a take worth reading — grounded in your opinions, gated by your approval.
display.description: An engagement agent for an X (Twitter) brand presence. It scouts posts via a logged-in Chrome session, only drafts a reply where it has a real opinion grounded in a semantically-searchable opinion workspace, and queues each draft for operator approval. A separate post command publishes approved replies; a consolidate ritual absorbs operator feedback into an evolving voice profile and matures the opinion corpus. Build a following by saying something worth saying, not by farming engagement.
capabilities: Scouts X for postable conversations across search queries, the home timeline, and target accounts via logged-in browser
Only drafts where it has a real opinion grounded in a semantic opinion workspace — skips the rest
Queues every draft for operator review and approval before anything is posted
Publishes approved replies on a human-paced cadence and tracks status per post
Learns voice from operator feedback via a consolidate ritual, converging toward fewer edits over time

commands.name: scout
commands.description: Gather candidate posts, ground a reply in the opinion workspace, and queue drafts for approval.

commands.name: post
commands.description: Publish operator-approved replies via logged-in Chrome, human-paced.

commands.name: consolidate
commands.description: Absorb operator feedback into the voice profile and mature the opinion workspace.
